newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech CEO details long-distance plans.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech CEO details long-distance plans.

text.p: Ameritech Corp expects next year to offer long-distance phone service in each of the five Midwestern states it now offers local phone service, the carrier's chief executive said Tuesday.
"Next year is our expectation in all five states," Richard Notebaert said in a conference call with reporters.
He was speaking after the Federal Communications Commission rejected the Chicago-based carrier's bid to offer long-distance service in Michigan.
